metadata.description: Built-in marketplace for cc-haha. Ships reverse-engineering, media-gen, and Spark2 game-development plugins.

plugins.name: reverse-engineering
plugins.description: Multi-platform reverse engineering toolkit. Static (Ghidra / radare2 / JADX / apktool) + dynamic (Frida instrumentation, GDB cross-arch single-step, LLDB Apple platforms) for binaries (PE/ELF/Mach-O), Android (APK), iOS, embedded firmware (MIPS/ARM/Cortex-M/PowerPC/68k/SuperH/RISC-V), and CTF.

plugins.name: media-gen
plugins.description: 多 Provider 图片与视频生成插件，支持图片生成与编辑、文生视频、图生视频、视频编辑和视频扩展，并提供显式模型选择与协议适配。

plugins.name: spark2-gamedev
plugins.description: 星火 2.0 (WasiCore) 游戏开发工具包。SCE 编辑器 MCP 桥接（数据/触发器/调试）+ 12 个开发技能，包含 UI 导出真实运行、全页面截图与资源兼容性验收。
